text:
mira: FYI MedBridge POC: some worker logs missing trace_id and theyre seeing short 429 bursts to their external collector. Need quick triage before Friday exec demo.

tom: Are they using our drain or the console forwarder?

mira: HTTP drain -> Datadog. Missing trace_id mostly from nightly backfills. 429s during spike replays.

nina: Likely header loss when enqueuing. Quick fix: attach x-redwood-trace on job enqueue and call redwood.context.propagate() in the worker.

phil: Also check SDK versionsold clients used x-rd-trace header name. If they upgraded recently, header mismatch causes blanks.

tom: I can bump their drain quota for the demo window to avoid 429s. Prefer to let them enable buffering on their collector long-term.

mira: Can we run a 10:30am PT verification? Need SE + SRE to watch live-tail and run a small burst.

nina: Ill open live-tail link and share filter: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/medbridge/live-tail. Use token MEDDBG-<unix> to search.

phil: PII concern: they want names/ssns removed. We have export transforms in Console -> Exports. Example rule: remove_field: ssn.

ops-bot: Quota update applied: `medbridge-poc` drain_rate 80->300 req/s by tom at 1965004380 UTC.

mira: Great. Tom/Nina please run the session and post results. If trace appears end-to-end and 429s stop, we'll close the ticket. If not, escalate to eng-oncall.
